title: Community Water Fluoridation and Birth Outcomes
abstract:
Community water fluoridation (CWF) is a widely implemented public health intervention aimed at preventing dental caries. However, concerns have emerged about potential unintended birth outcomes of fluoride exposure, particularly birth weight, which is a widely accepted summary measure of infant health and has been found to be associated with later-life health and human capital.
To evaluate the association between prenatal exposure to CWF and birth outcomes.
This cohort study was conducted using an event-study analysis with a difference-in-differences (DID) approach that exploited the staggered rollout of CWF across US counties from January 1968 to December 1988. The study included birth outcomes from singleton births obtained from the National Vital Statistics System’s Natality Detail Files. The analysis compared within-county changes in birth outcomes before and after the introduction of CWF, using counties that never fluoridated or had not yet fluoridated as the control. Data were analyzed between February 4 and October 28, 2025.
County-level CWF.
The primary outcome was change in mean birth weight, and secondary outcomes were incidence of low birth weight (<2500 g), gestational length (weeks), and incidence of prematurity (gestational age <37 weeks). Community water fluoridation exposure was measured as the population-weighted share of county residents served by fluoridated water based on Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Fluoridation Census data.
The study sample included 11 479 922 singleton births (mean [SD] gestational age, 39.5 [0.8] weeks; 51.2% boys; mean [SD] birth weight, 3337.4 [172.8] g; highest mean [SD] maternal age proportions, 0.36 [0.13] aged 20-24 years and 0.27 [0.12] aged 25-29 years) across 677 counties (408 CWF treated [60.3%] and 269 [39.7%] never treated) over the 21-year period, aggregated to the county-month level. No evidence of an association of CWF with birth weight or other birth outcomes was found (DID estimate, −0.53; 95% CI, −4.75 to 3.70). Event-study estimates showed no discernible pretreatment trends and no significant changes following CWF adoption, with estimates small in magnitude across all posttreatment periods, ranging from −8.44 g (95% CI, −20.41 to 3.53 g) to 7.20 g (95% CI, −5.45 to 19.85 g). Findings were supported by sensitivity analyses incorporating state-specific time trends, alternative exposure thresholds, and tests for compositional changes in births.
This cohort study of more than 11 million births found no association of CWF with adverse birth outcomes. These findings provide reassurance about the safety of CWF during pregnancy and underscore the value of rigorous causal designs in evaluating potential adverse effects of public health interventions.
abstract_zh:
社区供水氟化（CWF）是一项被广泛实施的公共卫生干预措施，旨在预防龋齿。然而，人们对氟暴露可能带来的非预期分娩结局表示担忧，尤其是出生体重——出生体重是婴儿健康被广泛接受的综合指标，并且已被发现与日后的健康和人力资本相关。
目的：评估产前暴露于社区供水氟化与分娩结局之间的关联。
本队列研究采用事件研究分析，并结合双重差分（DID）方法，利用1968年1月至1988年12月间美国各县交错推行社区供水氟化的机会进行研究。研究纳入了来自国家生命统计系统出生详细档案的单胎分娩结局。分析比较了社区供水氟化引入前后县内分娩结局的变化，并以从未氟化或尚未氟化的县作为对照。数据分析时间为2025年2月4日至10月28日。
暴露：县级社区供水氟化。
主要结局为平均出生体重的变化，次要结局包括低出生体重（<2500 g）发生率、妊娠时长（周）以及早产（胎龄<37周）发生率。社区供水氟化暴露以人口加权份额衡量，即基于美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）氟化普查数据，所服务于氟化饮用水的县居民比例。
研究样本包括11 479 922例单胎分娩（平均[标准差]胎龄39.5[0.8]周；男婴占51.2%；平均[标准差]出生体重3337.4[172.8] g；母亲年龄构成中占比最高的为20至24岁（0.36[0.13]）和25至29岁（0.27[0.12]）），涵盖21年期间的677个县（408个为社区供水氟化处理县[60.3%]，269个为从未处理县[39.7%]），并汇总至县—月层面。未发现社区供水氟化与出生体重或其他分娩结局存在关联（DID估计值为−0.53；95% CI为−4.75至3.70）。事件研究估计显示，处理前不存在明显趋势，社区供水氟化实施后也无显著变化，各处理后时期的估计值幅度都很小，范围从−8.44 g（95% CI为−20.41至3.53 g）到7.20 g（95% CI为−5.45至19.85 g）。敏感性分析——包括纳入州特定时间趋势、替代暴露阈值以及检验出生构成变化——也支持了这些发现。
本项对1100多万例分娩的队列研究发现，社区供水氟化与不良分娩结局之间不存在关联。这些发现为社区供水氟化在孕期的安全性提供了依据，并强调了在评估公共卫生干预可能产生的不良效应时，严谨的因果研究设计的价值。

title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals' willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP.Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 环境决策往往影响健康，然而发病率的估值仍然具有挑战性：现有方法（如疾病成本（COI）测度和质量调整生命年（QALY））未能反映个人为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出了一个跨健康状况评估发病率的新框架，利用广泛可得的偏好权重以及一个已知支付意愿的基准状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。我们的分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI测度，表明在政策评估中，健康状态被低估了。敏感性分析显示，其变化与统计生命价值（VSL）的结果相一致，这凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将发病率纳入环境政策分析提供了一个实用工具。

Occupational Exposure to Ambient Air Pollution: At-Risk Worker Groups, Regulatory and Research Needs An Official American Thoracic Society Workshop Report
venue: Annals of the American Thoracic Society, 22(11):1619-1632
abstract: Although health effects of ambient air pollution are well established in the general population, the impact of exposure in working populations remains poorly understood. Outdoor workers are disproportionately exposed to ambient air pollution, particularly with increasing wildfire smoke events and global climate change. An international interdisciplinary group of experts including worker representation assembled to review the current state of knowledge regarding the impact of occupational air pollution exposure on worker health and develop recommendations for research and actions to evaluate, mitigate, and regulate occupational air pollution exposure. The group identified health risks likely resulting from air pollution based on studies of the general population, noting that additional risks may be encountered from coexposures, as well as exertion increasing the work of breathing. High-risk groups were identified, including agricultural workers, construction workers, and wildland firefighters; others working in warehouses and indoor spaces are likely at risk via ambient air pollutant infiltration. It was estimated that at least 20 million outdoor U.S. workers are exposed to air pollution at work, which limits productivity and increases absenteeism. Participants recommended using air quality to guide work modifications and adoption of the hierarchy of exposure controls as a model to reduce exposures, as used by some states and proposed by the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health for agricultural and other outdoor workers. Existing research supports the urgent need for policies to protect workers from exposure. Research gaps remain, including medical surveillance strategies, improved technology to protect workers, and studies specifically evaluating the impacts of occupational air pollution exposure.
abstract_zh: 尽管环境空气污染对一般人群的健康影响已得到充分确立，但其对劳动人口的影响仍然鲜为人知。户外工作者尤其容易暴露于环境空气污染之中，而野火烟雾事件的增加和全球气候变化使这一问题更加突出。一个由专家组成的国际跨学科小组（包括工人代表）召开会议，以审查关于职业性空气污染暴露对工人健康影响的现有知识状况，并提出评估、减缓和监管职业性空气污染暴露的研究与行动建议。该小组基于一般人群的研究，识别出空气污染可能导致的健康风险，并指出可能还存在共同暴露的额外风险，以及体力活动加重呼吸负担所带来的风险。研究确定了高风险群体，包括农业工人、建筑工人和野外消防员；在仓库和室内空间工作的其他人员，也可能因环境空气污染的渗入而面临风险。据估计，美国至少有2000万名户外工人在工作中暴露于空气污染之中，这限制了生产率并增加了缺勤率。与会者建议，利用空气质量来指导工作安排调整，并采用暴露控制层级作为降低暴露的模式，这一做法已被部分州采用，也是美国国家职业安全与健康研究所（NIOSH）针对农业及其他户外工人所提出的。现有研究表明，迫切需要出台政策，保护工人免受暴露之害。研究空白依然存在，包括医学监测策略、保护工人的改进技术，以及专门评估职业性空气污染暴露影响的研究。

A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics
abstract: We provide new evidence that short-run temperature shocks affect unemployment dynamics. Linking daily weather data with three decades of Current Population Survey microdata, we show that cold, but not hot, temperatures significantly increase unemployment risk. This effect is concentrated in climate-exposed industries and driven by both increased job separations and longer unemployment durations. Separations appear to be driven by a rise in layoffs rather than quits, while the increase in unemployment duration is largely explained by a decline in employer vacancy postings. Taken together, temperature-induced joblessness dynamics are primarily demanddriven, rather than a result of changes in worker behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明短期温度冲击会影响失业动态。通过将逐日天气数据与三十年的当期人口调查（CPS）微观数据相联结，我们表明，寒冷而非炎热的气温会显著增加失业风险。这一效应集中于气候暴露型行业，并且由工作分离增加和失业持续时间延长共同驱动。工作分离似乎是由裁员而非主动离职的增加所驱动，而失业持续时间的延长在很大程度上可以由雇主招聘岗位的减少来解释。综合来看，温度引起的失业动态主要是需求驱动的，而非劳动者行为变化的结果。

title: Hot and Crowded: Temperature, Healthcare Utilization and Patient Outcomes
abstract: Extreme heat raises emergency demand and may increase mortality through hospital congestion when shocks hit many people at once. Using administrative records from Mexico’s largest public health system, we separate direct heat effects from congestion spillovers. Days with maximum temperature above 34°C increase ED visits by 6.9 percent and hospitalizations by 4.2 percent, with sicker ED patients discharged home more often. In-hospital deaths rise for already-admitted patients, suggesting important spillover effects, and deaths disproportionately increase outside hospitals. These results identify health-system capacity as an important margin of adaptation to extreme heat. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 极端高温会增加紧急医疗需求，并且当大量人口同时遭受冲击时，还可能通过医院拥堵而增加死亡率。我们利用墨西哥最大公共卫生系统的行政记录，将高温的直接效应与拥堵的溢出效应区分开来。最高气温超过34°C的日子，急诊就诊次数增加6.9%，住院人数增加4.2%，病情较重的急诊患者出院回家的比例也更高。已入院患者的院内死亡率上升，表明存在重要的溢出效应，并且死亡增加主要发生在医院之外。这些结果表明，卫生系统的容量是应对极端高温的重要适应途径。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

Air pollution accountability research: Moving from a chain to a web
abstract: Air pollution accountability studies examine the relationship(s) between an intervention, regulation, or event and the resulting downstream impacts, if any, on emissions, exposure, and/or health. The sequence of events has been schematically described as an accountability chain. Here, we update the existing framework to capture real-life complexities and to highlight important factors that fall outside the linear chain. This new "accountability web" is intended to convey the intricacies associated with conducting an accountability study to various audiences, including researchers, policy makers, and stakeholders. We also identify data considerations for planning and completing a robust accountability study, including those relevant to novel and innovative air pollution and exposure data. Finally, we present a series of recommendations for the accountability research community that can serve as a guide for the next generation of accountability studies.
abstract_zh: 空气污染问责研究考察干预、监管或事件与其对排放、暴露和/或健康所产生的下游影响（如有）之间的关系。这一事件序列曾被以示意方式描述为“问责链”。在此，我们更新了现有框架，以反映现实世界的复杂性，并突出那些落在线性链条之外的重要因素。这一新的“问责网络”旨在向包括研究人员、政策制定者和利益相关方在内的不同受众，传达开展问责研究所涉及的错综复杂性。我们还确定了规划和完成稳健问责研究时需要考虑的数据问题，包括与新颖且创新的空气污染和暴露数据相关的问题。最后，我们为问责研究界提出了一系列建议，可作为下一代问责研究的指南。

title: When Externalities Collide: Influenza and Pollution
abstract: Influenza and air pollution each pose significant public health risks with large global economic consequences. The common pathways through which each harms health presents an interesting case of compounding risk via interacting externalities. Using instrumental variables based on changing wind directions, we show increased levels of contemporaneous pollution significantly increase influenza hospitalizations. We exploit random variations in the effectiveness of the influenza vaccine as an additional instrument to show vaccine protection neutralizes this relationship. This suggests seemingly disparate policy actions of pollution control and vaccination campaigns jointly provide greater returns than those implied by addressing either in isolation.
abstract_zh: 流感和空气污染各自都对公共健康构成重大风险，并带来巨大的全球经济后果。两者损害健康的共同路径，构成了一个通过相互作用的外部性而产生叠加风险的有趣案例。利用基于风向变化的工具变量，我们表明，同期污染水平的上升会显著增加流感住院人数。我们利用流感疫苗有效性的随机变化作为额外的工具变量，表明疫苗保护可以抵消这一关系。这表明，看似截然不同的污染控制政策与疫苗接种运动，共同所产生的回报，将大于单独应对其中任何一项所产生的回报。

title: This is Air: The 'Non-Health' Effects of Air Pollution
abstract: A robust body of evidence shows that air pollution exposure is detrimental to health outcomes, often measured as deaths and hospitalizations. This literature has focused less on subclinical channels that nonetheless impact behavior, performance, and skills. This article reviews the economic research investigating the causal effects of pollution on "non-health" endpoints, including labor productivity, cognitive performance, and multiple forms of decision making. Subclinical effects of pollution can be more challenging to observe than formal health care encounters but may be more pervasive if they affect otherwise healthy people. The wide variety of possible impacts of pollution should be informed by plausible mechanisms and require appropriate hypothesis testing to limit false discovery. Finally, any detected effects of pollution, both in the short and long run, may be dampened by costly efforts to avoid exposure ex-ante and remediate its impacts ex-post; these costs must be considered for a full welfare analysis
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，空气污染暴露对健康结果有害，通常以死亡和住院来衡量。这一文献较少关注那些仍会影响行为、表现和技能的亚临床渠道。本文综述了考察污染对“非健康”终点的因果效应的经济学研究，这些终点包括劳动生产率、认知表现以及多种形式的决策。污染的亚临床效应可能比正式的医疗就诊更难观察，但如果它们影响的是原本健康的人群，则可能更为普遍。污染可能产生的各种影响，应当以合理的机制为依据，并需要进行适当的假设检验，以限制错误发现。最后，无论是短期还是长期检测到的污染效应，都可能因事前为避免暴露、事后为修复影响而付出的高昂代价而被削弱；为进行完整的福利分析，必须考虑这些成本。

title: Long-Run Pollution Exposure and Adult Mortality: Evidence from the Acid Rain Program
abstract: Though over 90 percent of benefits from environmental quality improvements are attributed to long-term exposure, nearly all quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of pollution on health exploits changes in short-term exposure. Quantifying long-run exposure impacts requires a lasting, exogenous change in ambient pollution. Even if the initial change in pollution is exogenous, the long-run nature allows more time for economic agents to respond to changes in pollution, resulting in endogenous pollution exposure. We estimate the effects of long-run pollution exposure on mortality among adults by exploiting the United States Acid Rain Program (ARP) as a natural experiment. The ARP, which regulated emissions from coal power plants, created a permanent change in pollution across vast distances, enabling us to define broad treatment areas to subsume many potential confounding effects. We use a differenceindifferences design, comparing changes in mortality over time in counties "near" regulated plants to changes in mortality in similar counties "far" from the plants. We find relative mortality in treatment counties decreased after the introduction of the ARP, with mortality improvements growing steadily over time in both economic and statistical significance. The ARP had no significant effect on residential sorting or employment, helping rule out selection or economic mechanisms. Analysis by cause of death supports the role of fine particulate matter as the relevant pollutant.
abstract_zh: 尽管环境质量改善所带来的效益中，超过90%归因于长期暴露，但几乎所有关于污染对健康影响的准实验证据，都利用的是短期暴露的变化。要量化长期暴露的影响，需要环境污染发生持久的、外生的变化。即便最初的污染变化是外生的，其长期性也为经济主体留出更多时间对污染变化作出反应，从而导致内生的污染暴露。我们利用美国酸雨计划（ARP）作为自然实验，估计长期污染暴露对成年人死亡率的影响。ARP对燃煤电厂的排放进行了管制，在广阔的地域范围内造成了持久的污染变化，使我们能够界定较大的处理区域，从而涵盖许多潜在的混杂效应。我们采用双重差分设计，比较“靠近”受管制电厂的县与“远离”电厂的相似县在死亡率随时间的变化。我们发现，在ARP实施之后，处理县的相对死亡率有所下降，并且死亡率改善在经济和统计意义上均随时间稳步增长。ARP对居民区分选或就业没有显著影响，这有助于排除选择性或经济机制。按死因分析支持了细颗粒物（PM2.5）是相关污染物的观点。

title: Temperature and work: Time allocated to work under varying climate and labor market conditions
abstract: Workers in climate exposed industries such as agriculture, construction, and manufacturing face increased health risks of working on high temperature days and may make decisions to reduce work on high-heat days to mitigate this risk. Utilizing the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) for the period 2003 through 2018 and historical weather data, we model the relationship between daily temperature and time allocation, focusing on hours worked by high-risk laborers. The results indicate that labor allocation decisions are context specific and likely driven by supply-side factors. We do not find a significant relationship between temperature and hours worked during the Great Recession (2008–2014), perhaps due to high competition for employment, however during periods of economic growth (2003–2007, 2015–2018) we find a significant reduction in hours worked on high-heat days. During periods of economic growth, for every degree above 90 on a particular day, the average high-risk worker reduces their time devoted to work by about 2.6 minutes relative to a 90-degree day. This effect is expected to intensify in the future as temperatures rise. Applying the modeled relationships to climate projections through the end of century, we find that annual lost wages resulting from decreased time spent working on days over 90 degrees across the United States range from $36.7 to $80.0 billion in 2090 under intermediate and high emission futures, respectively.
abstract_zh: 在农业、建筑和制造业等气候暴露型行业中工作的劳动者，在高温日工作面临更高的健康风险，因此可能会决定减少高温日的工作时间，以降低这一风险。利用2003至2018年的美国时间利用调查（ATUS）和历史气象数据，我们建立了逐日气温与时间分配之间的关系模型，重点关注高风险劳动者的工作时数。结果表明，劳动分配决策取决于具体情境，并且可能由供给侧因素驱动。在大衰退时期（2008–2014年），我们未发现气温与工作时数之间存在显著关系，这可能是由于就业竞争激烈所致；然而，在经济增长时期（2003–2007年、2015–2018年），我们发现高温日的工作时数显著减少。在经济增长时期，某一天的气温每超过90华氏度一度，平均而言，高风险劳动者相对于90华氏度的日子，其工作时间减少约2.6分钟。随着气温上升，这一效应预计将在未来加剧。将所建模的关系应用于截至本世纪末的气候预测，我们发现，在中等与高排放情景下，因超过90华氏度的日子工作时间减少而导致的美国年度工资损失，在2090年将分别达到367亿至800亿美元。

title: The Unintended Effects from Halting Nuclear Power Production: Evidence from the Fukushima Daiichi Accident
Using Crowd-Sourced Data to Assess the Temporal and Spatial Relationship between Indoor and Outdoor Particulate Matter
abstract: Using hourly measures across a full year of crowd-sourced data from over 1000 indoor and outdoor pollution monitors in the state of California, we explore the temporal and spatial relationship between outdoor and indoor particulate matter (PM) concentrations for different particle sizes. The scale of this study offers new insight into both average penetration rates and drivers of heterogeneity in the outdoor-indoor relationship. We find that an increase in the daily outdoor PM concentration of 10% leads to an average increase of 4.2-6.1% in indoor concentrations. The penetration of outdoor particles to the indoor environment occurs rapidly and almost entirely within 5 h. We also provide evidence showing that penetration rates are associated with building age and climatic conditions in the vicinity of the monitor. Since people spend a substantial amount of each day indoors, our findings fill a critical knowledge gap and have significant implications for government policies to improve public health through reductions in exposure to ambient air pollution.
abstract_zh: 利用加利福尼亚州超过1000个室内外污染监测仪一整年的逐小时众包数据，我们考察了不同粒径颗粒物（PM）浓度在室外与室内之间的时间和空间关系。本研究的规模为理解平均渗透率以及室内外关系异质性的驱动因素提供了新的见解。我们发现，室外日均PM浓度每增加10%，室内浓度平均增加4.2%至6.1%。室外颗粒物渗入室内环境的过程十分迅速，且几乎全部在5小时内完成。我们还提供了证据表明，渗透率与建筑年龄及监测点附近的气候条件相关。由于人们每天有相当长的时间待在室内，我们的发现填补了一项关键的知识空白，并对政府通过减少环境空气污染暴露来改善公众健康的政策具有重要意义。

title: What about tocilizumab? A retrospective study from a NYC Hospital during the COVID-19 outbreak
Estimating Causal Effects of Particulate Matter Regulation on Mortality
abstract:
Estimating the causal effect of pollution on human health is integral for evaluating returns to pollution regulation, yet separating out confounding factors remains a perennial challenge.
We use a quasi-experimental design to investigate the causal relationship between regulation of particulate matter smaller than 2.5 micrograms per cubic meter (PM2.5) and mortality among those 65 years of age and older. We exploit regulatory changes in the Clean Air Act Amendments (CAAA). Regulation in 2005 impacted areas of the United States differentially based on pre-regulation air quality levels for PM2.5. We use county-level mortality data, extracted from claims data managed by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, merged to county-level average PM2.5 readings and attainment status as classified by the Environmental Protection Agency.
Based on estimates from log-linear difference-in-differences models, our results indicate after the CAAA designation for PM2.5 in 2005, PM2.5 levels decreased 1.59 micrograms per cubic meter (95% CI = 1.39, 1.80) and mortality rates among those 65 and older decreased by 0.93% (95% CI = 0.10%, 1.77%) in nonattainment counties, relative to attainment ones. Results are robust to a series of alternate models, including nearest-neighbor matching based on propensity score estimates.
This analysis suggests large health returns to the 2005 PM2.5 designations, and provides evidence of a causal association between pollution and mortality among the Medicare population.
abstract_zh:
估计污染对人类健康的因果效应，是评估污染规制收益的关键，但如何剥离混杂因素始终是一个长期存在的挑战。
本文采用准实验设计，考察细颗粒物（PM2.5，直径小于2.5微米的颗粒物）规制与65岁及以上人群死亡率之间的因果关系。我们利用《清洁空气法修正案》（CAAA）的规制变化作为识别来源。2005年的规制对美国各地区的影响存在差异，其依据是各地区在规制前的PM2.5空气质量水平。我们使用医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）管理的理赔数据提取县级死亡率数据，并将其与县级平均PM2.5读数以及美国环境保护署（EPA）划定的达标状态相匹配。
基于对数线性双重差分模型的估计结果表明，在2005年PM2.5被划定为不达标地区后，不达标县的PM2.5水平下降了1.59微克每立方米（95%置信区间为1.39至1.80），65岁及以上人群的死亡率相对于达标县下降了0.93%（95%置信区间为0.10%至1.77%）。在一系列替代模型中，包括基于倾向得分估计的最近邻匹配，结果均保持稳健。
本分析表明，2005年PM2.5划定规制带来了巨大的健康收益，并为医疗保险人群中污染与死亡率之间的因果关联提供了证据。

title: The Effect of Pollution on Worker Productivity: Evidence from Call-Center Workers in China
abstract: We investigate the effect of pollution on worker productivity in the service sector by focusing on two call centers in China. Using precise measures of each worker's daily output linked to daily measures of pollution and meteorology, we find that higher levels of air pollution decrease worker productivity by reducing the number of calls that workers complete each day. These results manifest themselves at commonly found levels of pollution in major cities throughout the developing and developed world, suggesting that these types of effects are likely to apply broadly. When decomposing these effects, we find that the decreases in productivity are explained by increases in time spent on breaks rather than the duration of phone calls. To our knowledge, this is the first study to demonstrate that the negative impacts of pollution on productivity extend beyond physically demanding tasks to indoor, white-collar work.
abstract_zh: 我们以中国两家呼叫中心为对象，考察了污染对服务业劳动生产率的影响。通过将每位员工每日产出的精确测量与每日污染和气象数据相联结，我们发现，较高的空气污染水平会减少员工每日完成的通话数量，从而降低劳动生产率。这些结果在发展中国家和发达国家主要城市中常见的污染水平下即已显现，表明此类效应很可能具有广泛的适用性。在对这些效应进行分解后，我们发现，生产率的下降是由休息时间的增加所解释的，而非通话时长的变化。据我们所知，这是首个证明污染对生产率的负面影响不仅限于体力劳动，也延伸至室内白领工作的研究。

title: Pollution's Hidden Impacts
Temperature and Human Capital in the Short- and Long-Run
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 5(1)
abstract: We provide the first estimates of the potential impact of climate change on human capital, focusing on the impacts from both short-run weather and long-run climate. Exploiting the longitudinal structure of the NLSY79 and random fluctuations in weather across interviews, we identify the effect of temperature in models with child-specific fixed effects. We find that short-run changes in temperature lead to statistically significant decreases in cognitive performance on math (but not reading) beyond 26C (78.8F).In contrast, our long-run analysis, which relies upon long-difference and rich cross-sectional models, reveals no statistically significant relationship between climate and human capital. This finding is consistent with the notion that adaptation, particularly compensatory behavior, plays a significant role in limiting the long run impacts from short run weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们首次估计了气候变化对人力资本的潜在影响，重点关注短期天气与长期气候两方面的影响。利用NLSY79的纵向结构以及各次访谈之间天气的随机波动，我们在包含儿童个体固定效应的模型中识别温度的效应。我们发现，短期气温变化在超过26摄氏度（78.8华氏度）时，会导致数学（但非阅读）认知表现出现统计显著的下降。相比之下，我们依赖长差分和丰富的截面模型进行的长期分析，并未揭示气候与人力资本之间存在统计显著的关系。这一发现与如下观点一致：适应，特别是补偿性行为，在限制短期天气冲击的长期影响方面发挥了重要作用。

title: Air Pollution and Worker Productivity
Association of groundwater constituents with topography and distance to unconventional gas wells in NE Pennsylvania
Cost-effectiveness of Diabetes Screening Initiated through a Dental Visit
Energy Production and Health Externalities: Evidence from Oil Refinery Strikes in France
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 4(2)
abstract: This paper examines the effect of energy production on health using a recent strike that affected oil refineries in France as a natural experiment. First, we show that the temporary reduction in refining led to a significant reduction in sulfur dioxide (SO2) concentrations. Second, this shock significantly increased birth weight and gestational age of newborns, particularly for those exposed to the strike during the first and third trimesters of pregnancy, and decreased asthma and bronchitis admissions. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that a 1-unit (or 26%) decline in monthly SO2 leads to an €89 million increase in lifetime earnings per birth-year cohort. This externality from oil refineries should be an important part of policy discussions surrounding the production of energy.
abstract_zh: 本文以法国炼油厂的一次罢工作为自然实验，考察能源生产对健康的影响。首先，我们发现炼油产能的暂时下降显著降低了二氧化硫（SO2）浓度。其次，这一冲击显著提高了新生儿的出生体重和胎龄，对于在孕期前三个月和后三个月暴露于罢工的新生儿影响尤为明显，同时还减少了哮喘和支气管炎的住院人次。粗略估算表明，月度SO2每下降1个单位（或26%），每个出生年份队列的终身收入将增加8,900万欧元。炼油厂带来的这一外部性应当成为能源生产相关政策讨论的重要组成部分。

title: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Dental Sealants versus Fluoride Varnish in a School-Based Setting
Early-Life Exposure to the Great Smog of 1952 and the Development of Asthma
venue: Am J Respir Crit Care Med, 194(12)
abstract:
Little is known about the long-term effects of air pollution exposure and the root causes of asthma. We use exposure to intense air pollution from the 1952 Great Smog of London as a natural experiment to examine both issues.
To determine whether exposure to extreme air pollution in utero or soon after birth affects asthma development later in life.
This was a natural experiment using the unanticipated pollution event by comparing the prevalence of asthma between those exposed to the Great Smog in utero or the first year of life with those conceived well before or after the incident and those residing outside the affected area at the time of the smog.
Prevalence of asthma during childhood (ages 0–15) and adulthood (ages >15) is analyzed for 2,916 respondents to the Life History portion of the English Longitudinal Study on Aging born from 1945 to 1955. Exposure to the Great Smog in the first year of life increases the likelihood of childhood asthma by 19.87 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], 3.37–36.38). We also find suggestive evidence that early-life exposure led to a 9.53 percentage point increase (95% CI, −4.85 to 23.91) in the likelihood of adult asthma and exposure in utero led to a 7.91 percentage point increase (95% CI, −2.39 to 18.20) in the likelihood of childhood asthma.
These results are the first to link early-life pollution exposure to later development of asthma using a natural experiment, suggesting the legacy of the Great Smog is ongoing.
abstract_zh:
关于空气污染暴露的长期影响以及哮喘的根本成因，目前所知甚少。我们利用1952年伦敦大烟雾事件中的高强度空气污染作为自然实验，对这两个问题进行考察。
研究目的：确定子宫内或出生后不久暴露于极端空气污染，是否会影响其日后哮喘的发生。
研究设计：本研究以这一未曾预料的污染事件为自然实验，比较以下两组人群的哮喘患病率：一组是在子宫内或出生后第一年暴露于大烟雾的人群；另一组是在污染事件前后很久出生、或在事件发生时居住于受影响地区之外的人群。
研究对象与结果：本研究分析了英国老龄化纵向研究（English Longitudinal Study on Aging）生命史部分中1945年至1955年间出生的2,916名受访者在童年（0至15岁）和成年（15岁以上）时期的哮喘患病情况。出生后第一年暴露于大烟雾，使童年哮喘的发生概率增加19.87个百分点（95%置信区间[CI]为3.37至36.38）。我们还发现一些暗示性证据表明，早期生活暴露使成年哮喘的发生概率增加9.53个百分点（95% CI为-4.85至23.91），子宫内暴露使童年哮喘的发生概率增加7.91个百分点（95% CI为-2.39至18.20）。
研究结论：这些结果首次利用自然实验将早期生活污染暴露与其后哮喘的发生联系起来，表明大烟雾事件的遗留影响至今仍在持续。

title: Particulate Pollution and the Productivity of Pear Packers
abstract: We study the effect of outdoor air pollution on the productivity of indoor workers at a pear-packing factory. We focus on fine particulate matter (PM2.5), a harmful pollutant that easily penetrates indoor settings. We find that an increase in PM2.5 outdoors leads to a statistically and economically significant decrease in packing speeds inside the factory, with effects arising at levels well below current air quality standards. In contrast, we find little effect of PM2.5 on hours worked or the decision to work, and little effect of pollutants that do not travel indoors, such as ozone. This effect of outdoor pollution on the productivity of indoor workers suggests a thus far overlooked consequence of pollution. Backof-the-envelope calculations suggest that nationwide reductions in PM2.5 from 1999 to 2008 generated $19.5 billion in labor cost savings, which is roughly one-third of the total welfare benefits associated with this change.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了室外空气污染对一家梨类包装工厂室内工人生产率的影响。我们关注细颗粒物（PM2.5），这是一种易于渗入室内环境的有害污染物。我们发现，室外PM2.5浓度上升会导致工厂内包装速度出现具有统计意义和经济意义的显著下降，且这一影响在远低于当前空气质量标准的污染水平下即已出现。相比之下，我们发现PM2.5对工作时长或是否工作的决定几乎没有影响，而不会渗入室内的污染物（如臭氧）同样几乎没有影响。室外污染对室内工人生产率的这一影响，表明了一种迄今被忽视的污染后果。粗略测算显示，1999年至2008年全国范围内的PM2.5减排产生了195亿美元的劳动力成本节约，约占此项变化相关福利收益总额的三分之一。

title: Pollution and Climate Change
abstract: Childhood is a particularly sensitive time when it comes to pollution exposure. Allison Larr and Matthew Neidell focus on two atmospheric pollutants—ozone and particulate matter—that can harm children’s health in many ways. Ozone irritates the lungs, causing various respiratory symptoms; it can also damage the lung lining or aggravate lung diseases such as asthma. Particulate matter affects both the lungs and the heart; like ozone, it can cause respiratory symptoms and aggravate asthma, but it can also induce heart attacks or irregular heartbeat. Beyond those immediate effects, childhood exposure to ozone and particulate matter can do long-term damage to children’s health and reduce their ability to accumulate human capital. For example, frequent asthma attacks can cut into school attendance and academic performance, ultimately detracting from children’s ability to earn a good living as adults. Fossil fuel-burning power plants, which are a major source of carbon emissions that cause climate change, also emit high levels of nitrogen dioxide and sulfur dioxide, which play a role in forming ozone and particulate matter. We might assume, then, that policies to reduce climate change by cutting back on carbon emissions from power plants would automatically cut back on these other types of pollution. But it’s not quite that simple—atmospheric concentrations of ozone and particulate matter are linked to heat and other climatic variables through complex, nonlinear relationships. Taking those complex relationships into account and examining a variety of ways to model future air quality, Larr and Neidell project that policies to mitigate the emissions that produce climate change would indeed significantly reduce atmospheric ozone and particulate matter—at least in the United States, which has the most-complete data available to make such calculations. The drop in pollution would in turn produce significant improvements in child wellbeing. Children would be more likely to survive into adulthood, experience healthier childhoods, have more human capital, and be more productive as adults.
abstract_zh: 儿童期是对污染暴露尤为敏感的阶段。Allison Larr和Matthew Neidell关注两种大气污染物——臭氧和颗粒物，它们会以多种方式损害儿童健康。臭氧刺激肺部，引发各种呼吸道症状；它还会损伤肺部内膜，或加重哮喘等肺部疾病。颗粒物既影响肺部也影响心脏；与臭氧类似，它可引起呼吸道症状并加重哮喘，同时还可能诱发心脏病发作或心律失常。除了这些即时影响之外，儿童期暴露于臭氧和颗粒物还会对儿童健康造成长期损害，并降低其积累人力资本的能力。例如，频繁发作的哮喘会减少上学时间并影响学业表现，最终削弱儿童成年后获得良好收入的能力。燃烧化石燃料的发电厂是导致气候变化的碳排放的主要来源，同时也排放大量二氧化氮和二氧化硫，而这两种物质在臭氧和颗粒物的形成过程中发挥作用。因此，人们可能会认为，削减发电厂碳排放以应对气候变化的政策，会自动减少其他类型的污染。但事情并没有那么简单：大气中臭氧和颗粒物的浓度与气温及其他气候变量之间存在复杂的非线性关系。Larr和Neidell在充分考虑这些复杂关系并采用多种方式模拟未来空气质量后发现，减少导致气候变化的排放的政策，确实会显著降低大气中的臭氧和颗粒物浓度——至少在美国是如此，因为美国拥有进行此类计算所需的最完整数据。污染的下降进而将显著改善儿童福祉。儿童将更有可能存活到成年，拥有更健康的童年，积累更多人力资本，并在成年后更具生产力。

title: The Norwood operation: Relative effects of surgeon and institutional volumes on outcomes and resource utilization
Trends in mortality, length of stay, and hospital charges associated with health care-associated infections, 2006-2012
Unconventional Gas and Oil Drilling Is Associated with Increased Hospital Utilization Rates
abstract: Over the past ten years, unconventional gas and oil drilling (UGOD) has markedly expanded in the United States. Despite substantial increases in well drilling, the health consequences of UGOD toxicant exposure remain unclear. This study examines an association between wells and healthcare use by zip code from 2007 to 2011 in Pennsylvania. Inpatient discharge databases from the Pennsylvania Healthcare Cost Containment Council were correlated with active wells by zip code in three counties in Pennsylvania. For overall inpatient prevalence rates and 25 specific medical categories, the association of inpatient prevalence rates with number of wells per zip code and, separately, with wells per km2 (separated into quantiles and defined as well density) were estimated using fixed-effects Poisson models. To account for multiple comparisons, a Bonferroni correction with associations of p<0.00096 was considered statistically significant. Cardiology inpatient prevalence rates were significantly associated with number of wells per zip code (p<0.00096) and wells per km2 (p<0.00096) while neurology inpatient prevalence rates were significantly associated with wells per km2 (p<0.00096). Furthermore, evidence also supported an association between well density and inpatient prevalence rates for the medical categories of dermatology, neurology, oncology, and urology. These data suggest that UGOD wells, which dramatically increased in the past decade, were associated with increased inpatient prevalence rates within specific medical categories in Pennsylvania. Further studies are necessary to address healthcare costs of UGOD and determine whether specific toxicants or combinations are associated with organ-specific responses.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，非常规天然气和石油钻井（UGOD）在美国显著扩张。尽管钻井数量大幅增加，但UGOD有毒物质暴露对健康的影响仍不明确。本研究考察了2007年至2011年宾夕法尼亚州各邮政编码区内油气井与医疗服务利用之间的关联。我们将宾夕法尼亚州医疗成本控制委员会（Pennsylvania Healthcare Cost Containment Council）的住院出院数据，与宾夕法尼亚州三个县内按邮政编码统计的活跃油气井数据进行匹配。针对总体住院患病率以及25个具体医学类别，我们采用固定效应泊松模型，分别估计住院患病率与各邮政编码区油气井数量的关联，以及与每平方公里油气井数量（按分位数划分并定义为井密度）的关联。为校正多重比较问题，我们采用Bonferroni校正，以p<0.00096作为具有统计显著性的标准。心脏病学住院患病率与每邮政编码区油气井数量（p<0.00096）和每平方公里油气井数量（p<0.00096）均显著相关，而神经病学住院患病率与每平方公里油气井数量显著相关。此外，有证据还表明，井密度与皮肤科、神经科、肿瘤科和泌尿科等医学类别的住院患病率之间也存在关联。这些数据表明，在过去十年中大幅增加的UGOD油气井，与宾夕法尼亚州特定医学类别的住院患病率上升有关。未来仍需开展进一步研究，以评估UGOD的医疗成本，并确定特定有毒物质或其组合是否与器官特异性反应相关。

title: Prenatal exposure to airborne polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and IQ: estimated benefit of pollution reduction
Temperature and the Allocation of Time: Implications for Climate Change
abstract: In this paper we estimate the impacts of climate change on the allocation of time using econometric models that exploit plausibly exogenous variation in daily temperature over time within counties. We find large reductions in U.S. labor supply in industries with high exposure to climate and similarly large decreases in time allocated to outdoor leisure. We also find suggestive evidence of short-run adaptation through temporal substitutions and acclimatization. Given the industrial composition of the US, the net impacts on total employment are likely to be small, but significant changes in leisure time as well as large scale redistributions of income may be consequential. In developing countries, where the industrial base is more typically concentrated in climate-exposed industries and baseline temperatures are already warmer, employment impacts may be considerably larger.
abstract_zh: 本文利用计量经济模型估计了气候变化对时间配置的影响，该模型利用了县内每日气温随时间变化的、具有合理外生性的变异。我们发现，在受气候影响较大的行业中，美国劳动供给大幅减少，同时用于户外休闲的时间也出现了大幅下降。我们还发现了短期适应的暗示性证据，表现为时间上的替代和身体的适应性调整。鉴于美国的产业结构，气候变化对总就业的净影响可能较小，但休闲时间的显著变化以及大规模的收入再分配可能具有重要后果。在发展中国家，产业基础通常更集中于受气候影响较大的行业，且基准气温已经较高，因此就业影响可能要大得多。

title: What Do We Know About Short- and Long-Term Effects of Early-Life Exposure to Pollution?
abstract: Evidence shows that pollution exposure early in life is detrimental to near-term health, and an increasing body of evidence suggests that early-childhood health influences health and human capital outcomes later in life. This article reviews the economic research that brings these two literatures together. We begin with a conceptual model that highlights the core relationships across the life cycle. We then review the literature concerned with such estimates, focusing particularly on identification strategies to mitigate concerns regarding endogenous exposure. The nascent empirical literature provides both direct and indirect evidence that early-childhood exposure to pollution significantly impacts later-life outcomes. We discuss the potential policy implications of these long-lasting effects and conclude with a number of promising avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 证据表明，生命早期的污染暴露对近期健康有害，而且越来越多的证据表明，儿童早期的健康会影响其日后的健康和人力资本结果。本文回顾了将这两类文献结合起来的经济学研究。我们首先建立了一个概念模型，以突出贯穿整个生命周期的核心关系。随后，我们回顾了关于此类估计的文献，尤其关注用以减轻内生暴露顾虑的识别策略。新兴的实证文献既提供了直接证据，也提供了间接证据，表明儿童早期的污染暴露会显著影响日后的结果。我们讨论了这些持久影响的潜在政策含义，并以若干有前景的未来研究方向作结。

title: Disconcordance in statistical models of bisphenol A and chronic disease outcomes in NHANES 2003-08
Environment, Health, and Human Capital
abstract: In this review, we discuss three major contributions economists have made to our understanding of the relationship between the environment and individual well-being. First, in explicitly recognizing how optimizing behavior, particularly in the form of residential sorting, can lead to non-random assignment of pollution, economists have employed a wide range of quasi-experimental techniques to develop causal estimates of the effect of pollution. Second, economic research has placed a considerable focus on the role of avoidance behavior, which is an important component for understanding the difference between biological and behavioral effects of pollution and for proper welfare calculations. Lastly, economic research has expanded the focus of analysis beyond traditional health outcomes to include measures of human capital, including labor supply, productivity, and cognition. Our review of the quasi-experimental evidence on this topic suggests that pollution does indeed have a wide range of effects on individual well-being, even at levels well below current regulatory standards. Given the importance of health and human capital as an engine for economic growth, these findings underscore the role of environmental conditions as an important factor of production.
abstract_zh: 在本综述中，我们讨论了经济学家对理解环境与个人福祉之间关系所做的三项主要贡献。第一，经济学家明确认识到，最优化行为（尤其是居住地选择）可能导致污染的非随机分配，因此运用了多种准实验方法，以得出污染影响的因果估计。第二，经济学研究十分关注规避行为的作用，这对于理解污染的生物效应与行为效应之间的差异，以及进行恰当的福利计算，都是重要组成部分。最后，经济学研究已将分析重点从传统的健康结果扩展到人力资本的衡量，包括劳动供给、生产率和认知能力。我们对该主题准实验证据的综述表明，即使在远低于当前监管标准的水平下，污染确实对个人福祉产生广泛影响。鉴于健康和人力资本作为经济增长引擎的重要性，这些发现强调了环境条件作为一种重要生产要素的作用。

title: Gender Differences in Risk of Bloodstream and Surgical Site Infections
Something in the Water: Contaminated Drinking Water and Infant Health
abstract: This paper provides estimates of the effects of in utero exposure to contaminated drinking water on fetal health. To do this, we examine the universe of birth records and drinking water testing results for the state of New Jersey from 1997 to 2007. Our data enable us to compare outcomes across siblings who were potentially exposed to differing levels of harmful contaminants from drinking water while in utero. We find small effects of drinking water contamination on all children, but large and statistically significant effects on birth weight and gestation of infants born to less educated mothers. We also show that those mothers who were most affected by contamination were the least likely to move between births in response to contamination.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了子宫内暴露于受污染饮用水对胎儿健康的影响。为此，我们考察了1997至2007年间新泽西州全部的出生记录以及饮用水检测结果。我们的数据使我们能够比较在子宫内可能暴露于不同水平有害饮用水污染物的兄弟姐妹之间的结局。我们发现，饮用水污染对所有儿童的影响较小，但对受教育程度较低的母亲所生婴儿的出生体重和孕周有较大且具有统计显著性的影响。我们还表明，受污染影响最大的母亲，在两次分娩之间因污染而迁居的可能性最小。

title: Costs of Healthcare- and Community-Associated Infections with Antimicrobial-Resistant Versus Antimicrobial-Susceptible Organisms
On the Role of Length of Stay in Healthcare-associated Bloodstream Infection
The Impact of Pollution on Worker Productivity
abstract: Environmental protection is typically cast as a tax on the labor market and the economy in general. Since a large body of evidence links pollution with poor health, and health is an important part of human capital, efforts to reduce pollution could plausibly be viewed as an investment in human capital and thus a tool for promoting economic growth. While a handful of studies have documented the impacts of pollution on labor supply, this paper is the first to rigorously assess the less visible but likely more pervasive impacts on worker productivity. In particular, we exploit a novel panel dataset of daily farm worker output as recorded under piece rate contracts merged with data on environmental conditions to relate the plausibly exogenous daily variations in ozone with worker productivity. We find robust evidence that ozone levels well below federal air quality standards have a significant impact on productivity: a 10 ppb decrease in ozone concentrations increases worker productivity by 4.2 percent.
abstract_zh: 环境保护通常被视为对劳动力市场乃至整体经济的一种税负。由于大量证据表明污染与健康状况不佳相关，而健康是人力资本的重要组成部分，减少污染完全可以被视为一种人力资本投资，从而成为促进经济增长的工具。尽管已有少数研究记录了污染对劳动供给的影响，但本文首次严格评估了污染对工人生产率这一较为隐蔽、但可能更为普遍的影响。具体而言，我们利用一个新颖的面板数据集，该数据集记录了按件计酬合同下农场工人的每日产出，并将其与环境条件数据相匹配，从而将臭氧的每日外生性波动与工人生产率联系起来。我们发现了稳健的证据，表明远低于联邦空气质量标准的臭氧浓度对生产率有显著影响：臭氧浓度每降低10 ppb，工人生产率提高4.2%。

title: Pollution, Health, and Avoidance Behavior: Evidence from the Ports of Los Angeles
abstract: A pervasive problem in the literature on the health costs of pollution is that optimizing individuals may compensate for increases in pollution by reducing their exposure to protect their health. This implies that estimates of the health effects of pollution may vastly understate the full welfare effects of pollution, particularly for individuals most at risk who have the greatest incentive to adopt compensatory behavior. Furthermore, using ambient monitors to approximate individual exposure to pollution may induce considerable measurement error. We overcome these issues by estimating the short run effects of ozone on respiratory related health conditions using daily boat arrivals and departures into the two major ports of Los Angeles as an instrumental variable for ozone levels. While daily variation in boat traffic is a major contributor to local ozone pollution, time-varying pollution due to port activity is arguably a randomly determined event uncorrelated with factors related to health. Instrumental variable estimates are significantly larger than OLS estimates, indicating the importance of accounting for avoidance behavior and measurement error in understanding the full welfare effects from pollution.
abstract_zh: 污染健康成本文献中普遍存在一个问题：理性个体可能会通过减少暴露来保护自身健康，从而抵消污染增加带来的影响。这意味着，污染对健康影响的估计可能严重低估污染对福利的完整影响，尤其是对那些风险最高、因而采取补偿性行为动机最强的个体而言。此外，使用环境监测仪来近似个体的污染暴露，可能会引入相当大的测量误差。我们通过以洛杉矶两大港口每日船只进出港数量作为臭氧水平的工具变量，估计臭氧对呼吸系统相关健康状况的短期影响，从而克服了上述问题。虽然每日船舶流量的变化是当地臭氧污染的主要来源之一，但港口活动所导致的随时间变化的污染，可以认为是随机决定的事件，与健康相关因素不相关。工具变量估计结果显著大于OLS估计结果，这表明在理解污染的完整福利效应时，必须考虑规避行为和测量误差。

title: Quasi-experimental Studies Suggest that Lowering Air Pollution Levels Benefits Infants' and Children's Health
abstract: Many human studies have shown a correlation between air pollution and poor health in children. This paper focuses on studies that employ quasi-experimental designs to study the effects of air pollution on specific populations in an effort to isolate the causes and minimize the effect of confounding factors. Human studies of many and varied designs have found that exposure to some pollutants, even at levels below regulatory thresholds, adversely affects health. Our review of quasi-experimental studies adds additional support to these findings. Together, the research suggests that lowering the thresholds for acceptable air pollution levels may be a prudent and necessary step toward improving population health, especially among the most vulnerable members of society: infants and children. Policy makers should also consider providing specific information to families and pregnant women about when and where the risk of pollution exposure is highest, so that they can minimize their exposure or avoid it altogether.
abstract_zh: 许多人体研究表明，空气污染与儿童健康不良之间存在相关关系。本文关注那些采用准实验设计的研究，这些研究考察空气污染对特定人群的影响，以努力分离出其成因并最大限度地减少混杂因素的影响。各种不同设计的人体研究发现，即使在低于监管阈值的水平上，暴露于某些污染物也会对健康产生不利影响。我们对准实验研究的回顾为这些发现提供了更多支持。总体而言，研究表明，降低可接受的空气污染水平阈值，可能是改善人群健康，尤其是改善社会中最脆弱群体（婴儿和儿童）健康的审慎且必要的一步。政策制定者还应考虑向家庭和孕妇提供具体信息，告知她们污染暴露风险在何时何地最高，以便她们尽量减少暴露或完全避免暴露。

title: Air Quality Warnings and Outdoor Activities: Evidence from Southern California using a Regression Discontinuity Design
venue: Journal of Epidemiology and Community Health, 64(10)
abstract:
A study was undertaken to assess the impact of air quality warnings associated with ground-level ozone on outdoor activities in Southern California.
Data on aggregate daily attendance at two major outdoor facilities were collected and merged with observed and forecasted air quality and meteorology at the daily level. A quasi-experimental regression discontinuity design was used to estimate the impact of warnings.
Attendance declined significantly when stage 1 air quality warnings (‘smog alerts’) were issued. Consistent with expectations, responses were greater for populations more likely to be considered susceptible and more likely to be local residents.
Air quality warnings are an important policy tool for protecting the public's health from high levels of ambient air pollution.
abstract_zh:
本研究旨在评估与地面臭氧相关的空气质量预警对南加州户外活动的影响。
我们收集了两个主要户外场所每日总入场人数的数据，并将其与按日统计的实测及预报空气质量和气象数据进行匹配。我们采用准实验性断点回归设计来估计预警的影响。
当发布一级空气质量预警（“烟雾警报”）时，入场人数显著下降。与预期一致，更易受影响的人群以及更可能是本地居民的群体，其反应更为明显。
空气质量预警是保护公众健康免受高水平环境空气污染侵害的重要政策工具。

abstract:
Objectives. We sought to estimate the association between community water fluoridation (CWF) exposure at various stages of life and adult tooth loss.
Methods. We used data from the 1995 through 1999 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System, merged with data from the 1992 Water Fluoridation Census, to estimate interval regression models that relate CWF exposure with tooth loss.
Results. Our results indicate that CWF levels in the county of residence at the time of the respondent's birth are significantly related to tooth loss but current CWF levels are not. In addition, the impact of CWF exposure is larger for individuals of lower socioeconomic status.
Conclusions. This study suggests that the benefits of CWF may be larger than previously believed and that CWF has a lasting improvement in racial/ethnic and economic disparities in oral health.
abstract_zh:
目的。我们旨在估计社区饮用水氟化（CWF）在生命不同阶段的暴露与成人牙齿脱落之间的关联。
方法。我们使用1995年至1999年行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS）的数据，并与1992年饮用水氟化普查的数据相匹配，估计区间回归模型，以考察CWF暴露与牙齿脱落之间的关系。
结果。我们的结果表明，受访者出生时居住县的CWF水平与牙齿脱落显著相关，而当前的CWF水平则不相关。此外，CWF暴露的影响对于社会经济地位较低的个体更大。
结论。本研究表明，CWF的益处可能比以往认为的更大，并且CWF对口腔健康的种族/族裔和经济差距具有持久的改善作用。

Air Pollution and Infant Health: Lessons from New Jersey
abstract: We examine the impact of three "criteria" air pollutants on infant health in New Jersey in the 1990s by combining information about mother's residential location from birth certificates with information from air quality monitors. In addition to large sample size, our work offers three important innovations: First, because we know the exact addresses of mothers, we select those mothers closest to air monitors to ensure a more accurate measure of air quality. Second, since we follow mothers over time, we control for unobserved characteristics of mothers using maternal fixed effects. Third, we examine interactions of air pollution with smoking and other predictors of poor infant health outcomes. We find consistently negative effects of exposure to pollution, especially carbon monoxide, both during and after birth. The effects are considerably larger for smokers than for nonsmokers as well as for older mothers. Since automobiles are the main source of carbon monoxide emissions, our results have important implications for regulation of automobile emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们结合出生证明中母亲居住地的信息与空气质量监测站的信息，考察了20世纪90年代三种“标准”空气污染物对新泽西州婴儿健康的影响。除样本量大之外，我们的工作还有三项重要的创新：第一，由于我们掌握了母亲的确切住址，我们选择了离空气监测站最近的母亲，以确保对空气质量有更准确的测度。第二，由于我们对母亲进行了长期跟踪，我们利用母亲固定效应控制了母亲不可观测的特征。第三，我们考察了空气污染与吸烟以及其他不良婴儿健康结局预测因素之间的交互作用。我们发现，污染暴露，尤其是一氧化碳暴露，在出生期间及出生之后都具有一致的负面效应。对吸烟者以及年龄较大的母亲而言，效应明显更大。由于汽车是一氧化碳排放的主要来源，我们的结果对机动车排放的监管具有重要意义。

title: Days of Haze: Environmental Information Disclosure and Intertemporal Avoidance Behavior
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 58(2)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of informational regulatory approaches by analyzing the impact of smog alerts issued on consecutive days on discretionary outdoor activities in Southern California. Short-run adjustments to transitory risk entail costs that are likely to influence the set of evasive actions pursued by those at risk. Our results confirm that the cost of intertemporally substituting activities is increasing over time: when alerts are issued on two successive days, any response on the first day has largely disappeared by the second day. Small reprieves from alerts, however, reset these costs. Our findings imply that a time-varying decision rule that accounts for multiple day air quality forecasts may improve social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析加利福尼亚南部连续多日发布的烟雾预警对可自由支配户外活动的影响，考察了信息型监管方式的动态效应。短期内对暂时性风险的调整需要付出成本，这些成本很可能会影响风险人群所采取的规避行为组合。我们的结果证实，跨期替代活动的成本会随时间推移而上升：当连续两天发布预警时，第一天的任何应对行为到第二天大多已经消失。然而，预警的短暂中断会重置这些成本。我们的研究结果表明，考虑多日空气质量预测的时变决策规则可能会提高社会福利。

title: Does Pollution Increase School Absences?
abstract: We examine the effect of air pollution on school absences using administrative data for elementary and middle school children in 39 of the largest school districts in Texas merged with air quality information maintained by the Environmental Protection Agency. We address potentially confounding factors with a difference-in-difference-in-differences strategy that controls for persistent characteristics of schools, years, and attendance periods. Of the pollutants considered, we find that high carbon monoxide (CO) levels, even when below federal air quality standards, significantly increase absences. Our results suggest that the substantial decline in CO levels over the past two decades has yielded economically significant health benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们利用德克萨斯州39个最大学区的小学和初中学生行政数据，并与美国环境保护署维护的空气质量信息相匹配，考察空气污染对学生缺勤的影响。我们采用双重差分的三重差分策略来应对潜在的混杂因素，该策略控制了学校、年份和出勤周期的持久性特征。在所考察的污染物中，我们发现即使低于联邦空气质量标准，较高的一氧化碳（CO）水平也会显著增加缺勤。我们的结果表明，过去二十年间CO水平的大幅下降带来了显著的经济健康效益。

abstract: This paper assesses whether responses to information about risk impact estimates of the relationship between ozone and asthma in Southern California. Using a regression discontinuity design, I find smog alerts significantly reduces daily attendance at two major outdoor facilities. Using daily time-series regression models that include year-month and small area fixed effects, I find estimates of the effect of ozone for children and the elderly that include information are significantly larger than estimates that do not. These results are consistent with the hypothesis that individuals take substantial action to reduce exposure to risk; estimates ignoring these actions are severely biased.
abstract_zh: 本文考察人们对风险信息的反应是否会影响对臭氧与哮喘关系的估计，研究地点为南加州。利用断点回归设计，我发现烟雾警报会显著减少两个主要户外场所的每日入场人数。利用包含年-月和小区域固定效应的日度时间序列回归模型，我发现，纳入信息反应的臭氧对儿童和老年人的影响估计值，显著大于未纳入信息反应的估计值。这些结果与以下假说一致：个体会采取大量行动以降低风险暴露；忽略这些行为的估计存在严重偏误。

Air Pollution and Infant Health: What Can We Learn from California's Recent Experience?
abstract: We examine the impact of air pollution on infant death in California over the 1990s. Our work offers several innovations: First, many previous studies examine populations subject to far greater levels of pollution. In contrast, the experience of California in the 1990s is clearly relevant to current debates over the regulation of pollution. Second, many studies examine a few routinely monitored pollutants in isolation, generally because of data limitations. We examine four "criteria" pollutants in a common framework. Third, we develop an identification strategy based on within zip code variation in pollution levels that controls for potentially important unobserved characteristics of high pollution areas. Fourth, we use rich individual-level data to investigate effects of pollution on infant mortality, fetal deaths, low birth weight and prematurity in a common framework. We find that the reductions in carbon monoxide (CO) and particulates (PM10) over the 1990s in California saved over 1,000 infant lives. However, we find little consistent evidence of pollution effects on fetal deaths, low birth weight or short gestation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了20世纪90年代空气污染对加利福尼亚州婴儿死亡的影响。我们的工作具有若干创新之处：第一，以往许多研究考察的是暴露于远为严重污染水平下的人群。相比之下，加利福尼亚州在20世纪90年代的经历与当前关于污染监管的辩论显然高度相关。第二，许多研究由于数据限制，通常孤立地考察少数常规监测的污染物。我们则在统一的框架下考察了四种“标准”污染物。第三，我们基于邮政编码区内部污染水平的变化设计了识别策略，该策略控制了高污染地区可能存在的重要不可观测特征。第四，我们利用丰富的个体层面数据，在统一框架下考察了污染对婴儿死亡、胎儿死亡、低出生体重和早产的影响。我们发现，20世纪90年代加利福尼亚州一氧化碳（CO）和颗粒物（PM10）的减少挽救了逾1000名婴儿的生命。然而，我们几乎没有发现污染对胎儿死亡、低出生体重或短孕周存在一致证据。

title: Air Pollution, Health, and Socio-Economic Status: The Effect of Outdoor Air Quality on Childhood Asthma
